t: This is Tavistock Square, a public garden in Bloomsbury, in the London Borough of Camden, close to Euston Station. The master builder Thomas Cubitt designed it; he shaped many of London's historic streets and squares, especially in Belgravia, Pimlico and Bloomsbury. The square also carries a sadder memory. Hasib Hussain, at eighteen the youngest of the four suicide bombers of the 7 July 2005 London bombings, died here. Others connected to the square include the missionary Jessie Pigott, born here, who was later killed in the Taiyuan massacre, and the businessman Henry John Gardiner, who lived here.
